scripts.build:core: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --minify --legal-comments=none --platform=browser --target=es2018 --tree-shaking=true --outfile=src/.bundle.tmp.js && terser src/.bundle.tmp.js --ecma 2018 --compress passes=12,unsafe=true,unsafe_comps=true,unsafe_math=true,unsafe_methods=true,hoist_funs=true,hoist_vars=true,reduce_vars=true,collapse_vars=true,drop_console=true,pure_getters=true,booleans_as_integers=true --mangle toplevel=true --mangle-props "regex=/^(giftAddInFlight|giftAddError|mutating|suppressCartRefresh|cartListenersInstalled|knownGiftVariantId|campaignLoaded|ht|ds|uh|ud|cl|lc|cb|sv|se|sr|sp|autoAddGift|rewardType|unlockedGifts|nextTier|rewardTiers)$/" --output ../extensions/free-gift-progress-bar/assets/free-gift-progress-bar.js && node -e "require('fs').unlinkSync('src/.bundle.tmp.js')"
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:compat && node ../scripts/storefront-assets.mjs
